scripts.dev: doppler run -p genlexis -c dev -- vite dev
scripts.build: doppler run -p genlexis -c prod -- vite build
scripts.prepare: playwright install && pnpm gen && svelte-kit sync || echo '' && husky
scripts.check: doppler run -p genlexis -c dev -- svelte-kit sync && pnpm generated:postprocess && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.test: doppler run -p genlexis -c test -- pnpm test:run
scripts.test:e2e: doppler run -p genlexis -c test -- playwright test
scripts.db:push:dev: doppler run -p genlexis -c dev -- pnpm db:push
scripts.db:generate:dev: doppler run -p genlexis -c dev -- pnpm db:generate
scripts.db:migrate:dev: doppler run -p genlexis -c dev -- pnpm db:migrate
scripts.db:migrate:prod: doppler run -p genlexis -c prod -- pnpm db:migrate
scripts.db:studio:dev: doppler run -p genlexis -c dev -- pnpm db:studio
